drivingQuestion: What does the mishna's first clause teach?
outcomeNote: The clause teaches that a group can be replaced wholesale.

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ מַאי קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן? הָא קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דְּאַף עַל גַּב דְּאִימְּנִי עָלָיו חֲבוּרָה זוֹ, חוֹזֶרֶת וְנִמְנִין עָלָיו חֲבוּרָה אַחֶרֶת.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «What» is the first clause of the mishna «teaching us?» It is obvious that additional people can be registered. «This comes to teach us that although this group was registered for it,» the entire group «can withdraw and a different group can register for it,» despite the fact that no one from the original group remains.
